Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

HaploBreedR 0.99.1

Initial submission

First release. The package accompanies the manuscript describing haplotype-based breeding decisions in rice.

Superior-haplotype discovery

  • haplobreed_analysis(): single-trait pipeline from GWAS hits or a gene list to a superior haplotype per candidate gene. Builds LD decay and LD regions from the genotype, discovers functional variants (nonsynonymous CDS and UTR) in every tested gene, tests haplotype-trait associations (Student’s t-test / one-way ANOVA, optional PC correction, Tukey and Duncan post-hoc), and applies effect-size, permutation and false-discovery gates. Supports local, MSU7, RAP-DB and Ensembl Plants reference sources.

  • hbr_generate_input_qc_report(): unified input-QC report covering sequence-resource quality, genotype-reference compatibility and individual-ID overlap, written as a text report and three CSV tables.

  • hbr_check_inputs(): pre-flight validation of PLINK files, phenotype records, GFF3 features and sample-ID overlap before launching the full pipeline.

  • hbr_go_enrichment(): GO over-representation per aspect (BP, MF, CC) against the tested-gene universe, with BH-FDR correction.

  • hbr_regate(): re-applies the superior-haplotype gates (alpha, effect size, optional FDR, optional trait threshold) directly to a stored summary table for sensitivity analysis.

  • hbr_read_results(): ingests a completed per-trait output directory into a classed hbr_run object for downstream visualisation or genomic selection.

  • hbr_gene_carriers(): extracts per-individual carrier status of the pipeline’s superior haplotype at a given gene, used to colour prediction-quality panels.

  • hbr_add_cross_annotation() (internal): MSU7 ↔︎ RAP-DB gene-ID mapping from the RAP-DB release table; GO attachment via org.Osativa.eg.db when installed.

Genomic prediction and breeding decisions

  • hbr_advanced_decision(): multi-trait parent ranking and cross design from one or more haplobreed_analysis() runs. Two-kernel genomic BLUP (VanRaden 2008; Kang et al. 2008) with the pipeline’s superior haplotypes as the feature kernel; honest nested cross-validation with in-fold discovery replay (M0 = GBLUP, M2 = features chosen on all data, M3 = features re-discovered inside each training fold) and a paired comparison of the three (Nadeau and Bengio 2003 corrected t-test plus a paired bootstrap over individuals).

  • hbr_fit_models(): the phenotype-dependent half of the pipeline (loading, GRM, haplotype codes, gate replay, cross-validation, final models, multi-trait index). Returns an hgsi_fit object that can be saved once and reused.

  • hbr_cross_design(): the second half of the pipeline. Consumes an hgsi_fit object, groups superior haplotypes into haplotype blocks, computes cross usefulness (Schnell and Utz 1975; Zhong and Jannink 2007), pyramiding probabilities and required population sizes (Sedcole 1977), and selects a diverse parent set by block coverage with a relatedness ceiling.

  • Cross ranking by usefulness, block coverage, or a balanced mix; haplotype-pyramiding probabilities and DH / RIL / F2 population sizing.

  • Exported modular building blocks: hbr_build_grm(), hbr_reml_two_kernel(), hbr_cross_usefulness(), hbr_pyramid_probability(), hbr_population_size(), hbr_cross_plan(), hbr_trait_conflicts().

Haplotype blocks

  • hbr_haplotype_blocks(): standalone block calling on any set of target loci. Supports the map-based rules ("recomb", "ld", "either"), the SNP-level methods ("fourgamete", "gabriel") and the two combinations ("recomb+gabriel", "recomb+fourgamete"). Gabriel is implemented with the Gabriel et al. (2002) D′ confidence interval and vectorised pairwise gamete counting.

  • hbr_haplotype_block_table(): the block summary table and the per-locus assignment in one call, for users who want the block table without the full pipeline.

Genetic map

  • hbr_rice_genetic_map(): the Nagamura et al. (1997) rice RFLP linkage-map anchors (n ≈ 1,650 markers, total 1,510 cM) as a data frame with chr, bp, cm. Interpolated at run time onto the physical positions of any PLINK .bim with a monotone cubic Hermite spline.

  • hbr_rice_genetic_map_summary(): one-row summary of the bundled anchors.

Visualisation

  • Publication-quality figures for haplotype structure, gene models, LD structure and cross design: hbr_plot_haplotype(), hbr_plot_gene_list(), hbr_plot_gene_structure(), hbr_plot_haplotype_network(), hbr_plot_ld_heatmap(), hbr_plot_superior_haplotype(), hbr_plot_cross_ranking(), hbr_plot_cv_forest(), hbr_plot_cv_optimism(), hbr_plot_prediction_quality(), hbr_plot_selected_set_coverage(), hbr_plot_parent_profile(), hbr_plot_cross_landscape().

  • S3 methods for the pipeline objects: plot() and summary() for hbr_run and hgsi_advanced; print() and summary() for hgsi_fit; print() for hbr_reference, hbr_sequence_qc, hbr_compat_report, hbr_id_report and hbr_genotype.

  • Ten built-in colour palettes and ten ggplot2 themes; per-gene marker colours derived from the IUPAC allele set via hbr_cell_colours().

Manuscript tables and exported building blocks

  • hbr_build_manuscript_tables(): a multi-sheet Excel workbook from a pipeline run, with study summary, gene results, donor tables and breeding decisions.

Reference layer

  • hbr_crop_lookup(): built-in crop-to-species-to-assembly lookup for Ensembl Plants; refreshable against the live FTP listing.

  • Local, MSU7, RAP-DB and Ensembl Plants reference sources; chromosome names standardised on every slot so they match the genotype convention applied by hbr_normalize_genotype().

Reproducibility and performance

  • Every run writes pipeline_summary.csv, phenotype_data_used.csv, functional_snps_all_tested_genes.csv, gene_attrition_log.csv and pipeline_result_for_breeding.rds; the RDS carries the gate parameters and the exact phenotype table used, so downstream runs can be replayed without any external state.

  • Genotype reads are streamed through BEDMatrix, so peak memory is one column block rather than the full genotype matrix; the RDS genotype packing is streamed from the same handle.

  • hbr_advanced_decision() records provenance, warnings and the evaluation label per trait (honest_discovery_in_fold, conditional_on_gwas_candidates, conditional_on_discovered_set, approximate_replay).

  • verbose in every function selects a single-line-per-phase console summary; the detailed narration is available by passing verbose = TRUE where noted.
